Here’s the high-level architecture of **JoyShockMapper**.

## 1) Composition root and process control

The application is launched and orchestrated from:

- [main.cpp](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro

-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/src/main.cpp)

`main.cpp` is where startup, command wiring, backend wiring, and runtime lifecycle are managed:
- command-line/config loading

- backend selection setup
- device connection/reconnect orchestration
- callback registration (button/motion/touch/input-state)
- background services (`AutoLoad`, `AutoConnect`)
- periodic cleanup and shutdown

## 2) Backend abstraction

layer (input source)

Input comes through a unified wrapper interface:

- [JslWrapper.h](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShock

Mapper/include/JslWrapper.h)

Two concrete implementations provide the same API:
- [JslWrapper.cpp](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/J

oyShockMapper/src/JslWrapper.cpp) (JoyShockLibrary path)
- [SDLWrapper.cpp](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/Joy

ShockMapper/src/SDLWrapper.cpp) (SDL3 path)

Build-time selection in CMake decides which path is compiled.

## 3) Core per-device domain model

Each connected controller is represented by:

- [JoyShock.h]

(/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/include/JoyShock.h)
- [JoyShock.cpp](/home/jangman/Projects

/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/src/JoyShock.cpp)

`JoyShock` encapsulates:
- mapping state per handle
- calibration/motion helpers
-

trigger/state caches
- currently active `DigitalButton` set
- settings view for that device instance

## 4) Mapping and input-to-action execution

Mapping pipeline is split into parse + runtime execution:

- [Mapping.h](/
home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/include/Mapping.h) + [Mapping.cpp](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJy

ro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/src/Mapping.cpp)
- [DigitalButton.h](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-J
SM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/include/DigitalButton.h) + [DigitalButton.cpp](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM

/JoyShockMapper/src/DigitalButton.cpp)

- `Mapping` parses human mapping syntax and resolves target actions/events.
- `DigitalButton` implements the finite-state behavior (press/release/tap/hold/turbo etc.) and calls

`EventActionIf` handlers to emit side effects.

## 5) Motion/touch/analog support modules

Motion and helpers are explicit submodules:

- [MotionImpl.cpp](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro

-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/src/MotionImpl.cpp)
- [Stick.h](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM

/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/include/Stick.h)
- [InputHelpers.h](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/Joy

ShockMapper/include/InputHelpers.h) + platform versions in `src/win32` and `src/linux`

These feed transformed stick/mouse/gyro/touch intent into digital/action execution.

## 6) Settings and command system

-
[SettingsManager.h](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/include/SettingsManager.h) + [SettingsManager.cpp](/home

- [JSMVariable.hpp](/home/jangman/Projects/J

- [JSMAssignment.hpp](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM

- [CmdRegistry.h](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-J
SM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/include/CmdRegistry.h) + [CmdRegistry.cpp](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM

/JoyShockMapper/src/CmdRegistry.cpp)

This module manages runtime options, command parsing, macro assignment, and dynamic listeners between settings/actions.

## 7) Output abstractions

Host-side output and virtual controller output are separated:

-

[InputHelpers] handles key/mouse and console/window-level integration.
- [Gamepad.h](/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShock

Mapper/include/Gamepad.h) + Windows implementations in `src/win32/Gamepad.cpp`

So actions can target

:
- keyboard/mouse events,
- virtual gamepad emission,
- physical-device haptics/light via wrapper API.

ro-JSM/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/include/Whitelister.h)
  - Windows HidHide/HidGuardian implementations, Linux stub.

- [AutoLoad]([/home

- [AutoConnect]([/home/jangman/Projects/JangsJyro-JSM/J

/JangsJyro-JSM/JoyShockMapper/src/AutoConnect.cpp)

They add behavioral automation based on active window and connection changes.

- `Jsl

Wrapper/SDLWrapper` : input source abstraction  
- `JoyShock` : per-device state machine coordinator
